rule: Application close counts come from the snapshot taken before harness cleanup. Harness close is recorded separately and is not counted as application cleanup.

other_schedules.both_locked: created 5, published 5, harness closed 5 after snapshot
other_schedules.cleanup_fails: application close of 12 raised and left it open; application closed 13; harness closed 12; globals stayed empty
other_schedules.release_during_init: application did not close 14; harness closed it
other_schedules.release_borrowed: application closed the only connection; harness closed 0
other_schedules.replace_during_close: application closed 16; 17 was published and open; harness closed 17
other_schedules.retry: failed connect created no object; application did not close 18; harness closed 18

lifespan_success_path: A successful startup leaves the published connection open. Harness close of that object is not an application leak.
lifespan_startup_stop: Application retained the connection on purpose after Telegram stop failed. Harness closed it afterward.
